message: ### What changed? Why was the change needed? Updated the `describe()` strings in all e2e tests within `apps/api/src/app/translations/e2e/v1`. Specifically: * Replaced `#novu-v1` with `#novu-v2` to align with new test categorization. * Prepended `[V1 Translations]` to each `describe()` string. This is to clearly identify these as legacy V1 tests that must continue to run, ensuring backward compatibility for existing customers. ### Screenshots --- [Slack Thread](https://novu.slack.com/archives/D0919LNS89H/p1758053280308669?thread_ts=1758053280.308669&cid=D0919LNS89H)
